methodologyNotes: Covers head-worn LED headlamps mounted on an elastic headband or strap, sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes handheld flashlights (see flashlights), helmet-only work lights sold without a strap, and hard-hat clip lamps. Price is MSRP or typical street price in USD. maxLumens is the manufacturer's peak output in lumens on the highest (turbo/boost) mode, not a sustained figure. maxBeamDistanceMeters is the rated maximum beam throw in meters on the highest mode. runtimeMaxHrs is the longest manufacturer-published burn time in hours, measured on the lowest steady output setting (reserve/moonlight excluded). weightGrams is the total weight in grams as worn, including headband and the battery it ships with. batteryType is an enum: built-in-li-ion (sealed rechargeable pack), removable-li-ion (swappable rechargeable cell/pack), aaa (disposable/NiMH AAA cells), or hybrid (accepts both a li-ion pack and disposable cells). batteryCapacityMah is the rated capacity of the included battery in mAh; null if the light runs only on user-supplied disposable cells or capacity is not disclosed. rechargePort is an enum: usb-c, micro-usb, magnetic, proprietary, or none (non-rechargeable). waterproofRating is the IEC IP/IPX ingress code exactly as published (e.g. IPX4, IP67); null if not disclosed. redLight is a boolean for a dedicated red LED or red mode. reactiveLighting is a boolean for an onboard ambient-light sensor that auto-adjusts brightness. beamType is an enum: flood, spot, mixed, or adjustable-focus.

products.provenance: The official Petzl USA product page identifies this as the 625-lumen ACTIK CORE (SKU E065AB00) at $87.95 and lists verbatim specs: "Brightness: 625 lumens (ANSI/PLATO FL 1)", "Weight: 88 g", "Watertightness: IPX4", USB-C charging, and "CORE rechargeable battery (1250 mAh) or 3 AAA/LR03 batteries" (HYBRID CONCEPT); its lighting table gives MAX POWER 625 lm / 115 m / 2 h and MAX BURN TIME 7 lm / 100 h, and it describes a "Mixed beam (wide and focused)" with continuous red lighting. US retailer BrightGuy corroborates the exact 625-lumen model (P/N E065AB00, 1250 mAh, USB-C, 115 m beam range, 3.1 oz) at the identical $87.95 price, confirming the model-identity check (not the older 450/600-lumen variant). No fetched page stated a release year, so releaseDate is null; reactiveLighting is false as the Actik Core has no ambient-light sensor (a feature Petzl reserves for its REACTIVE LIGHTING models).
